subject: Biology SL
title: Biology SL Paper 2 Section A Mock v3

questions.subject: Biology SL
questions.question: Researchers measured lung function before and after a bronchodilator in two groups. Answer all parts using the data.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question: Calculate the percentage increase in FEV₁ after treatment in Group B.
markscheme: Increase = 2.45 − 1.75 = 0.70 dm³.
Percentage increase = 0.70 ÷ 1.75 × 100 = 40%.

parts.label: (b)
parts.question: Compare the effect of treatment in Groups A and B.
markscheme: Both groups show an increase in FEV₁ after treatment.
The absolute and/or percentage increase is greater in Group B than in Group A.
markschemeJa: 両群とも治療後にFEV₁が増加する。
絶対増加量または割合増加はB群の方がA群より大きい。
parts.modelAnswer: Both improve, but Group B shows the larger response.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 両群とも改善しますが、B群の方が反応が大きいです。

parts.label: (c)
parts.question: Explain how narrowing of airways can reduce gas exchange during exercise.
markscheme: Airway narrowing increases resistance to airflow and reduces ventilation of alveoli.
Reduced ventilation can lower the oxygen concentration gradient between alveolar air and blood.
Less oxygen diffuses into blood per unit time, limiting oxygen delivery during exercise.
markschemeJa: 気道狭窄は気流抵抗を増やし肺胞換気を低下させる。
換気低下により肺胞気と血液間の酸素濃度勾配が小さくなりうる。
単位時間の酸素拡散量が減り運動時の酸素供給が制限される。
parts.modelAnswer: Narrow airways reduce alveolar ventilation, weakening gas-exchange gradients and reducing oxygen uptake.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 狭い気道は肺胞換気を減らし、ガス交換勾配を弱めて酸素取り込みを低下させます。

parts.label: (d)
parts.question: Evaluate whether the results prove that the bronchodilator will improve exercise performance in all people.
markscheme: The treatment improves FEV₁ in both sampled groups, supporting improved airflow.
Exercise performance was not measured directly, so improved FEV₁ does not prove improved performance.
Individual variation, other physiological limits and sample size mean the result cannot be generalized to all people without further evidence.
markschemeJa: 両群でFEV₁が改善しており気流改善を支持する。
運動能力を直接測定していないためFEV₁改善だけで運動能力改善は証明できない。
個人差、他の制限要因、標本数のため全員へ一般化するには追加証拠が必要。
parts.modelAnswer: The data support improved airflow but do not measure exercise performance directly and cannot establish benefit for every individual.
parts.modelAnswerJa: データは気流改善を支持しますが運動能力を直接測っておらず、全員への効果を証明できません。

parts.label: (e)
parts.question: Suggest two additional measurements that would help test the claim about exercise performance.
markscheme: Measure exercise performance directly, for example time to exhaustion / workload / running time.
Measure oxygen uptake or blood oxygen saturation during standardized exercise.
markschemeJa: 持久時間、仕事量、走行時間など運動能力を直接測定する。
標準化した運動中の酸素摂取量または血中酸素飽和度を測定する。
parts.modelAnswer: Measure standardized exercise performance and oxygen uptake or blood oxygen saturation.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 標準化した運動能力と酸素摂取量または血中酸素飽和度を測定します。

stimulus.title: FEV₁ before and after bronchodilator
stimulus.note: FEV₁ is the volume exhaled in the first second of a forced expiration.

questions.subject: Biology SL
questions.question: The same homologous DNA region was compared among four populations.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question: Identify the pair with the smallest sequence difference.
markscheme: P and Q.
markschemeJa: PとQ。

parts.label: (b)
parts.question: Explain what the small sequence difference suggests about evolutionary relationship.
markscheme: Fewer differences in the same homologous DNA region generally indicate greater genetic similarity.
Greater similarity supports a more recent common ancestor, assuming comparable mutation rates and homologous sequences.
markschemeJa: 同じ相同DNA領域で差が少ないほど一般に遺伝的類似性が高い。
類似性が高いことは、比較条件が適切ならより最近の共通祖先を支持する。
parts.modelAnswer: P and Q are likely more closely related and share a more recent common ancestor.
parts.modelAnswerJa: PとQはより近縁で、より最近の共通祖先をもつ可能性が高いです。

parts.label: (c)
parts.question: Evaluate whether DNA difference alone is sufficient to decide that P and Q are the same species.
markscheme: DNA similarity provides useful evidence but there is no universal sequence-difference threshold that defines all species.
Species decisions may also require reproductive, morphological, ecological or behavioral evidence.
markschemeJa: DNA類似性は有用だが全ての生物に共通する種判定の配列差閾値はない。
生殖、形態、生態、行動など他の証拠も必要な場合がある。
parts.modelAnswer: DNA data support close relatedness but should be combined with other evidence before concluding that the populations are the same species.
parts.modelAnswerJa: DNAは近縁性を支持しますが、同一種と結論するには他の証拠と組み合わせるべきです。

questions.subject: Biology SL
questions.question: Net carbon dioxide uptake was measured at different light intensities and carbon dioxide concentrations.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question: Compare the effect of increasing light intensity at low and high carbon dioxide concentration.
markscheme: At both carbon dioxide concentrations, uptake increases as light intensity initially increases.
The increase is greater at high CO₂; at low CO₂ the rate approaches a lower plateau.
markschemeJa: 両CO₂濃度で初めは光強度上昇により取り込みが増える。
高CO₂で増加が大きく、低CO₂ではより低い値で頭打ちになる。
parts.modelAnswer: Higher light increases uptake in both treatments, but the response is larger at high CO₂.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 光を強くすると両条件で取り込みが増えますが、高CO₂の方が増加が大きいです。

parts.label: (b)
parts.question: Explain why increasing CO₂ has little effect at the lowest light intensity.
markscheme: At very low light, light-dependent reactions provide limited energy/reducing power for carbon fixation.
Light is the main limiting factor, so extra CO₂ cannot be used at a much higher rate.
markschemeJa: 非常に低い光では炭素固定に必要なエネルギー・還元力の供給が限られる。
光が主要な制限要因なのでCO₂を増やしても利用速度は大きく上がらない。
parts.modelAnswer: Light is limiting at the lowest intensity, so extra CO₂ has little effect.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 最低光強度では光が制限要因なので、CO₂を増やしても効果が小さいです。

parts.label: (c)
parts.question: Suggest two variables that should be controlled.
markscheme: Control temperature.
Control another relevant variable such as leaf area, plant species/age, water supply or measurement time.
markschemeJa: 温度を一定にする。
葉面積、植物種・齢、水供給、測定時間など別の適切な変数を一定にする。
parts.modelAnswer: Keep temperature and leaf area constant.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 温度と葉面積を一定にします。

questions.subject: Biology SL
questions.question: A double-stranded DNA sample contains 18% guanine.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question: Calculate the expected percentages of cytosine and adenine.
markscheme: Cytosine = 18% because G pairs with C.
G + C = 36%, leaving 64% for A + T; adenine = 32%.
markschemeJa: GとCが対になるためC＝18%。
parts.modelAnswerJa: シトシン18%、アデニン32%です。

parts.label: (b)
parts.question: Explain how complementary base pairing contributes to accurate DNA replication.
markscheme: Each parental DNA strand acts as a template for a new strand.
Specific A–T and C–G pairing determines the sequence of complementary nucleotides.
markschemeJa: 各親DNA鎖が新生鎖の鋳型となる。
A–T、C–Gの特異的対合が相補ヌクレオチド配列を決める。
parts.modelAnswer: Each template strand directs a complementary sequence through specific base pairing.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 各鋳型鎖が特異的塩基対形成により相補配列を決めます。

parts.label: (c)
parts.question: State why DNA replication is described as semi-conservative.
markscheme: Each daughter DNA molecule contains one parental strand and one newly synthesized strand.
markschemeJa: 各娘DNA分子は親鎖1本と新生鎖1本を含む。
parts.modelAnswer: Each daughter molecule contains one old strand and one new strand.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 各娘DNAは古い鎖1本と新しい鎖1本を含みます。

questions.subject: Biology SL
questions.question: Two insect populations experienced dry and moist environments for 20 generations.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question: Describe the change in allele X frequency in the dry environment.
markscheme: Allele X frequency increases steadily over generations.
It rises from 0.12 to 0.76 by generation 20.
markschemeJa: X頻度は世代とともに継続的に増える。
0.12から20世代で0.76へ上昇する。
parts.modelAnswerJa: Xは0.12から0.76へ継続的に増加します。

parts.label: (b)
parts.question: Compare the pattern in the dry and moist environments.
markscheme: X rises strongly in the dry environment but remains near its starting frequency in the moist environment.
markschemeJa: 乾燥環境では大きく増えるが湿潤環境では開始頻度付近にとどまる。
parts.modelAnswer: X increases strongly only in the dry environment.
parts.modelAnswerJa: Xは乾燥環境でのみ大きく増えます。

parts.label: (c)
parts.question: Explain how natural selection could produce the difference.
markscheme: If X increases fitness in dry conditions, carriers leave more surviving offspring and transmit X more often.
If X gives little or no advantage in moist conditions, selection for X is weak and its frequency changes little.
markschemeJa: Xが乾燥条件で適応度を高めれば保有個体がより多く子孫を残しXを伝える。
湿潤条件で利点が小さければXへの選択は弱く頻度変化も小さい。
parts.modelAnswer: An environment-specific fitness advantage causes X to increase in dry conditions but not strongly in moist conditions.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 環境依存の適応度上昇によりXは乾燥条件で増え、湿潤条件ではほとんど増えません。

parts.label: (d)
parts.question: Suggest one reason why replicate populations would strengthen the conclusion.
markscheme: Replicate populations would show whether the pattern is repeatable and reduce the chance that the result is due to random genetic drift or sampling variation.
markschemeJa: 反復集団により傾向の再現性を確認でき、遺伝的浮動や標本変動による偶然の結果である可能性を下げられる。
parts.modelAnswer: Replicate populations would test whether the pattern is repeatable rather than a chance result.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 反復集団を使えば、傾向が偶然ではなく再現するか確認できます。
